name: warm-compact
description: Compacts an idle session just before its prompt cache goes cold, so the next prompt reads a short summary instead of the whole conversation uncached. A footer chip and /warm-compact turn it off for a session.

minTokens.title: Smallest context to compact
minTokens.description: A conversation smaller than this many tokens is left alone: reading it uncached costs little.

leadSeconds.title: Seconds before the cache expires
leadSeconds.description: How long before the cache would go cold the compaction starts.
